articles.title: Tunnel vision: the plan to link the Shetland Islands
articles.summary: Campaigners in the remote Shetland Islands are advocating for a significant infrastructure upgrade. They propose replacing the region's ageing ferry system with undersea tunnels to overcome the high costs and logistical challenges of island connectivity. This initiative aims to improve local transport reliability and reduce isolation for residents, highlighting a growing push for modern solutions to improve remote area accessibility.

articles.title: Orion Health founder Ian McCrae launches AI health-tech start-up, including new tool to stop deadly prescription errors
articles.summary: McCrae founded McCrae Tech, driven by a personal commitment to AI, which he actively pursued. The new tech venture was established with proceeds from the substantial $205 million sale of Auckland-based Orion Health to a Canadian company. This marks McCrae's transition from a successful health technology sale into a new enterprise focused on artificial intelligence, leveraging significant funds for his latest endeavor.

articles.title: Next personal care home to be built in Manitoba will be in Winnipeg's Bridgwater area: premier
articles.summary: Manitoba, Canada, will see a new 140-bed personal care home built in Winnipeg's Bridgwater area. The NDP government announced $95 million in funding for the project, which is part of several previously planned initiatives. This development aims to expand long-term care capacity within the province, addressing critical healthcare infrastructure needs.
